Where to stay

Accommodations in Soma Bay

Soma Bay is a self-contained luxury peninsula with a handful of world-class resorts, all within minutes of Seba by CJC. We recommend booking early as October is peak season on the Red Sea.

⚠
Book early

October is peak season on the Red Sea — we strongly recommend securing your accommodation as early as possible. Rooms fill up fast around our date.
